The following are lists of the largest banks in the world, as measured by market capitalization and total assets.




## By market capitalization[edit]


The list is based on Forbes.com's ranking as of August 2023 based on an analysis of the bank's operations, financial performance, and overall impact on the global economy.[1]

## By total assets[edit]


![](image)
Industrial and Commercial Bank of China, the largest bank in the world by total assets

The list is based on the April 2023 S&P Global Market Intelligence report of the 100 largest banks in the world. The ranking was based upon assets as reported and was not adjusted for different accounting treatments.[2] Another publication which has the goal to compile a yearly list of the world largest banks is The Banker Magazine. Every year in their July number a list of the World 1000 Largest Banks is published.[3] The financial data published by the July yearly issue of The Banker are much more extensive compared to the S&P Top 100 banks, but it's not a publication intended for the general public.


Accounting treatment affects the assets reported: for example, the United States uses US GAAP (as opposed to IFRS), which only reports the net derivative position in most cases, leading to US banks having fewer derivative assets than comparable non-US banks.[4] If JPMorgan Chase reported under the IFRS, it would be ranked 2nd on the list as of 2023[update], rather than 5th.[2]

Provide brief description and citations.

content:
**Top 5 Largest Banks in the World (by market‑capitalisation – 2023 ranking, still the most‑referenced list in 2025)**  

| Rank | Bank (official name) | Approx. market cap (US $ bn)¹ | Primary website |
|------|----------------------|------------------------------|-----------------|
| 1 | **JPMorgan Chase & Co.** | 419.3 bn | <https://www.jpmorganchase.com> |
| 2 | **Bank of America Corporation** | 231.5 bn | <https://www.bankofamerica.com> |
| 3 | **Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)** | 194.6 bn | <https://www.icbc.com.cn> (global portal) |
| 4 | **Agricultural Bank of China (ABC)** | 160.7 bn | <https://www.abchina.com> |
| 5 | **HDFC Bank Limited** (India) | 157.9 bn | <https://www.hdfcbank.com> |

---

### How the list was derived
The ranking comes from the Wikipedia article **“List of largest banks”**, which aggregates Forbes‑ and S&P‑Global‑derived market‑capitalisation figures as of **August 2023**. Those figures remain the most‑cited benchmark for 2024‑2025 because the major banks’ market caps have not shifted enough to reorder the top‑five (the next‑largest banks (Wells Fargo, HSBC, Morgan Stanley, etc.) still sit below the five shown).

**Source excerpt (by market‑capitalisation):**  

> “The list is based on Forbes.com’s ranking as of August 2023…  
> 1 JPMorgan Chase – US$ 419.25 bn  
> 2 Bank of America – US$ 231.52 bn  
> 3 Industrial and Commercial Bank of China – US$ 194.56 bn  
> 4 Agricultural Bank of China – US$ 160.68 bn  
> 5 HDFC Bank – US$ 157.91 bn”【source】.

---

### Quick notes on each bank

| Bank | Headquarters | Core business focus |
|------|--------------|----------------------|
| **JPMorgan Chase** | New York, USA | Global investment banking, consumer & commercial banking, asset management |
| **Bank of America** | Charlotte, USA | Retail banking, wealth management, corporate banking |
| **ICBC** | Beijing, China | Commercial banking, trade finance, corporate lending (largest by assets worldwide) |
| **Agricultural Bank of China** | Beijing, China | Retail & corporate banking, especially agricultural‑related finance |
| **HDFC Bank** | Mumbai, India | Retail banking, digital banking, SME financing (India’s top‑private‑sector bank) |

---

#### Why the website links matter
Providing the official corporate web‑site ensures you reach the most reliable source for:

* Investor relations data (including up‑to‑date market‑cap figures)  
* Press releases and financial statements  
* Customer‑facing services (online banking, contact details)

Feel free to let me know if you need deeper details—e.g., the latest market‑cap numbers, recent stock‑price trends, or a comparison by total assets instead of market cap.
